title: NECO Financial Accounting Part 2: Partnerships, Companies & the Financial System - Financial Accounting - Capital and recurrent expenditures

subject: Financial Accounting

questions.q: Which of the following is correctly classified as a **recurrent expenditure** of the government?
options: Construction of an interstate dual-carriageway expressway
Payment of monthly civil service salaries, allowances, and pensions
Procurement of specialized military transport aircraft
Building and equipping a new state teaching hospital
questions.explain:
*   **Recurrent Expenditure:** Ongoing, day-to-day operational costs of running the government that recur every year and do not create long-term physical assets (e.g., civil service salaries, office supplies, utilities, and pensions).
*   **Capital Expenditure:** Spending on acquiring, constructing, or improving long-term physical infrastructure and fixed assets (e.g., roads, hospitals, aircraft).
